CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 6, 2023
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 8:30 AM

Erik Frost Hollins, President  Joen Garnica, Commissioner
Robyn Gordon-Peterson, Vice President  Victoria Love, Commissioner
  Jose Osuna, Commissioner

Christina Pizarro Winting, Executive Director

  SPECIAL MEETING

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 8:42 a.m., President Frost Hollins called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Hollins, Gordon-Peterson, Love

 Commissioners Absent: Garnica, Osuna

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 Julia Smay, Executive Assistant, led the pledge of allegiance.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 There were no comments from the public.

 CLOSED SESSION

 1.  23-51468  Closed Session- Personnel Session Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54957(B)(1)

  President Frost Hollins announced that the Commission was going into closed
  session at 8:44 a.m.

  The Commission returned from closed session at 8:54 a.m.

 2.  23-51469  Recommendation to approve protest of examination item(s) – Port Security System
  Operator.

  A motion was made by Vice President Gordon-Peterson, seconded by
  Commissioner Love, to approve staff’s recommendation to deny protest. The
  motion carried by the following vote:
